verses.original: Τότε ὁμοιωθήσεται ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν δέκα παρθένοις αἵτινες λαβοῦσαι τὰς λαμπάδας ἑαυτῶν ἐξῆλθον εἰς ὑπάντησιν τοῦ νυμφίου
verses.transliteration: Tote homoiōthēsetai hē basileia tōn ouranōn deka parthenois haitines labousai tas lampadas heautōn exēlthon eis hypantēsin tou nymphiou
verses.literal: At that time the kingdom of heaven will be like ten virgins who took their lamps and went out to meet the bridegroom

verses.original: πέντε δὲ ἐξ αὐτῶν ἦσαν μωραὶ καὶ πέντε φρόνιμοι
verses.transliteration: pente de ex autōn ēsan mōrai kai pente phronimoi
verses.literal: Five of them were foolish and five were wise

verses.original: αἱ γὰρ μωραὶ λαβοῦσαι τὰς λαμπάδας αὐτῶν οὐκ ἔλαβον μεθ’ ἑαυτῶν ἔλαιον
verses.transliteration: hai gar mōrai labousai tas lampadas autōn ouk elabon meth’ heautōn elaion
verses.literal: The foolish ones took their lamps but did not take along . . . . . . any extra oil

verses.original: αἱ δὲ φρόνιμοι ἔλαβον ἔλαιον ἐν τοῖς ἀγγείοις μετὰ τῶν λαμπάδων ἑαυτῶν
verses.transliteration: hai de phronimoi elabon elaion en tois angeiois meta tōn lampadōn heautōn
verses.literal: But the wise ones took oil in flasks along with their lamps

verses.original: χρονίζοντος δὲ τοῦ νυμφίου ἐνύσταξαν πᾶσαι καὶ ἐκάθευδον
verses.transliteration: chronizontos de tou nymphiou enystaxan pasai kai ekatheudon
verses.literal: When the bridegroom was delayed they all became drowsy and fell asleep

verses.original: Μέσης δὲ νυκτὸς κραυγὴ γέγονεν Ἰδοὺ ὁ νυμφίος ἐξέρχεσθε εἰς ἀπάντησιν αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Mesēs de nyktos kraugē gegonen Idou ho nymphios exerchesthe eis apantēsin autou
verses.literal: At midnight . . . the cry rang out Here is the bridegroom Come out to meet him

verses.original: Τότε ἠγέρθησαν πᾶσαι αἱ παρθένοι ἐκεῖναι καὶ ἐκόσμησαν τὰς λαμπάδας ἑαυτῶν
verses.transliteration: Tote ēgerthēsan pasai hai parthenoi ekeinai kai ekosmēsan tas lampadas heautōn
verses.literal: Then all the virgins woke up and trimmed their lamps

verses.original: αἱ δὲ μωραὶ ταῖς φρονίμοις εἶπαν Δότε ἡμῖν ἐκ τοῦ ἐλαίου ὑμῶν ὅτι αἱ λαμπάδες ἡμῶν σβέννυνται
verses.transliteration: hai de mōrai tais phronimois eipan Dote hēmin ek tou elaiou hymōn hoti hai lampades hēmōn sbennyntai
verses.literal: The foolish ones said to the wise Give us some of your oil our lamps are going out

verses.original: Ἀπεκρίθησαν δὲ αἱ φρόνιμοι λέγουσαι Μή¦Ποτε οὐ μὴ ἀρκέσῃ ἡμῖν καὶ ὑμῖν πορεύεσθε μᾶλλον πρὸς τοὺς πωλοῦντας καὶ ἀγοράσατε ἑαυταῖς
verses.transliteration: Apekrithēsan de hai phronimoi legousai Mē¦Pote ou mē arkesē hēmin kai hymin poreuesthe mallon pros tous pōlountas kai agorasate heautais
verses.literal: No said the wise ones . . . or there may not be enough for both us and you Instead go to those who sell oil and buy some for yourselves

verses.original: Ἀπερχομένων δὲ αὐτῶν ἀγοράσαι ἦλθεν ὁ νυμφίος καὶ αἱ ἕτοιμοι εἰσῆλθον μετ’ αὐτοῦ εἰς τοὺς γάμους καὶ ἐκλείσθη ἡ θύρα
verses.transliteration: Aperchomenōn de autōn agorasai ēlthen ho nymphios kai hai hetoimoi eisēlthon met’ autou eis tous gamous kai ekleisthē hē thyra
verses.literal: But while they were on their way to buy it the bridegroom arrived Those who were ready went in with him to the wedding banquet and the door was shut

verses.original: Ὕστερον δὲ ἔρχονται καὶ αἱ λοιπαὶ παρθένοι λέγουσαι Κύριε κύριε ἄνοιξον ἡμῖν
verses.transliteration: Hysteron de erchontai kai hai loipai parthenoi legousai Kyrie kyrie anoixon hēmin
verses.literal: Later the other virgins arrived and said Lord lord open the door for us

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν οὐκ οἶδα ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: Ho de apokritheis eipen Amēn legō hymin ouk oida hymas
verses.literal: But he replied . . . Truly I tell you I do not know you

verses.original: Γρηγορεῖτε οὖν ὅτι οὐκ οἴδατε τὴν ἡμέραν οὐδὲ τὴν ὥραν
verses.transliteration: Grēgoreite oun hoti ouk oidate tēn hēmeran oude tēn hōran
verses.literal: Therefore keep watch because you do not know the day or the hour

verses.original: Ὥσπερ γὰρ ἄνθρωπος ἀποδημῶν ἐκάλεσεν τοὺς ἰδίους δούλους καὶ παρέδωκεν αὐτοῖς τὰ ὑπάρχοντα αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Hōsper gar anthrōpos apodēmōn ekalesen tous idious doulous kai paredōken autois ta hyparchonta autou
verses.literal: For it is just like a man going on a journey who called his servants and entrusted them with his possessions

verses.original: καὶ ᾧ μὲν ἔδωκεν πέντε τάλαντα ᾧ δὲ δύο ᾧ δὲ ἕν ἑκάστῳ κατὰ τὴν ἰδίαν δύναμιν καὶ ἀπεδήμησεν
verses.transliteration: kai hō men edōken pente talanta hō de dyo hō de hen hekastō kata tēn idian dynamin kai apedēmēsen
verses.literal: To one he gave five talents to another two talents and to another one talent each according to his own ability And he went on his journey

verses.original: Εὐθέως Πορευθεὶς ὁ τὰ πέντε τάλαντα λαβὼν ἠργάσατο ἐν αὐτοῖς καὶ ἐκέρδησεν ἄλλα πέντε
verses.transliteration: Eutheōs Poreutheis ho ta pente talanta labōn ērgasato en autois kai ekerdēsen alla pente
verses.literal: The servant who had received the five talents went at once and put them to work . . . . . . and gained five more

verses.original: ὡσαύτως ὁ τὰ δύο ἐκέρδησεν ἄλλα δύο
verses.transliteration: hōsautōs ho ta dyo ekerdēsen alla dyo
verses.literal: Likewise the one with the two talents gained two more

verses.original: ὁ δὲ τὸ ἓν λαβὼν ἀπελθὼν ὤρυξεν γῆν καὶ ἔκρυψεν τὸ ἀργύριον τοῦ κυρίου αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: ho de to hen labōn apelthōn ōryxen gēn kai ekrypsen to argyrion tou kyriou autou
verses.literal: But the servant who had received the one talent went off dug a hole in the ground and hid his master’s money

verses.original: Μετὰ δὲ πολὺν χρόνον ἔρχεται ὁ κύριος τῶν δούλων ἐκείνων καὶ συναίρει λόγον μετ’ αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: Meta de polyn chronon erchetai ho kyrios tōn doulōn ekeinōn kai synairei logon met’ autōn
verses.literal: After a long time the master of those servants returned and settled accounts with them

verses.original: καὶ προσελθὼν ὁ τὰ πέντε τάλαντα λαβὼν προσήνεγκεν ἄλλα πέντε τάλαντα λέγων Κύριε πέντε τάλαντά μοι παρέδωκας ἴδε ἄλλα πέντε τάλαντα ἐκέρδησα
verses.transliteration: kai proselthōn ho ta pente talanta labōn prosēnenken alla pente talanta legōn Kyrie pente talanta moi paredōkas ide alla pente talanta ekerdēsa
verses.literal: The servant who had received the five talents came and presented five more Master he said you entrusted me with five talents See I have gained five more

verses.original: Ἔφη αὐτῷ ὁ κύριος αὐτοῦ Εὖ δοῦλε ἀγαθὲ καὶ πιστέ ἐπὶ ὀλίγα ἦς πιστός ἐπὶ πολλῶν σε καταστήσω εἴσελθε εἰς τὴν χαρὰν τοῦ κυρίου σου
verses.transliteration: Ephē autō ho kyrios autou Eu doule agathe kai piste epi oliga ēs pistos epi pollōn se katastēsō eiselthe eis tēn charan tou kyriou sou
verses.literal: His master replied Well done good and faithful servant You have been faithful with a few things I will put you in charge of many things Enter into the joy of your master

verses.original: Προσελθὼν δὲ καὶ ὁ τὰ δύο τάλαντα εἶπεν Κύριε δύο τάλαντά μοι παρέδωκας ἴδε ἄλλα δύο τάλαντα ἐκέρδησα
verses.transliteration: Proselthōn de kai ho ta dyo talanta eipen Kyrie dyo talanta moi paredōkas ide alla dyo talanta ekerdēsa
verses.literal: The servant who had received the two talents also came and said Master you entrusted me with two talents See I have gained two more

verses.original: Ἔφη αὐτῷ ὁ κύριος αὐτοῦ Εὖ δοῦλε ἀγαθὲ καὶ πιστέ ἐπὶ ὀλίγα ἦς πιστός ἐπὶ πολλῶν σε καταστήσω εἴσελθε εἰς τὴν χαρὰν τοῦ κυρίου σου
verses.transliteration: Ephē autō ho kyrios autou Eu doule agathe kai piste epi oliga ēs pistos epi pollōn se katastēsō eiselthe eis tēn charan tou kyriou sou
verses.literal: His master replied Well done good and faithful servant You have been faithful with a few things I will put you in charge of many things Enter into the joy of your master

verses.original: Προσελθὼν δὲ καὶ ὁ τὸ ἓν τάλαντον εἰληφὼς εἶπεν Κύριε ἔγνων σε ὅτι σκληρὸς εἶ ἄνθρωπος θερίζων ὅπου οὐκ ἔσπειρας καὶ συνάγων ὅθεν οὐ διεσκόρπισας
verses.transliteration: Proselthōn de kai ho to hen talanton eilēphōs eipen Kyrie egnōn se hoti sklēros ei anthrōpos therizōn hopou ouk espeiras kai synagōn hothen ou dieskorpisas
verses.literal: Finally the servant who had received the one talent came and said Master I knew that you are a hard man reaping where you have not sown and gathering where you have not scattered seed

verses.original: καὶ φοβηθεὶς ἀπελθὼν ἔκρυψα τὸ τάλαντόν σου ἐν τῇ γῇ ἴδε ἔχεις τὸ σόν
verses.transliteration: kai phobētheis apelthōn ekrypsa to talanton sou en tē gē ide echeis to son
verses.literal: So I was afraid and went out and hid your talent in the ground See you have what belongs to you

verses.original: Ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ κύριος αὐτοῦ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Πονηρὲ δοῦλε καὶ ὀκνηρέ ᾔδεις ὅτι θερίζω ὅπου οὐκ ἔσπειρα καὶ συνάγω ὅθεν οὐ διεσκόρπισα
verses.transliteration: Apokritheis de ho kyrios autou eipen autō Ponēre doule kai oknēre ēdeis hoti therizō hopou ouk espeira kai synagō hothen ou dieskorpisa
verses.literal: You wicked lazy servant replied . . . . . . his master You knew that I reap where I have not sown and gather where . . . I have not scattered seed

verses.original: ἔδει σε οὖν βαλεῖν τὰ ἀργύριά μου τοῖς τραπεζίταις καὶ ἐλθὼν ἐγὼ ἐκομισάμην ἂν τὸ ἐμὸν σὺν τόκῳ
verses.transliteration: edei se oun balein ta argyria mou tois trapezitais kai elthōn egō ekomisamēn an to emon syn tokō
verses.literal: Then you should have deposited my money with the bankers and on my return I would have received it back with interest

verses.original: Ἄρατε οὖν ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ τὸ τάλαντον καὶ δότε τῷ ἔχοντι τὰ δέκα τάλαντα
verses.transliteration: Arate oun ap’ autou to talanton kai dote tō echonti ta deka talanta
verses.literal: Therefore take the talent from him and give it to the one who has ten talents

verses.original: τῷ γὰρ ἔχοντι παντὶ δοθήσεται καὶ περισσευθήσεται τοῦ δὲ μὴ ἔχοντος καὶ ὃ ἔχει ἀρθήσεται ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: tō gar echonti panti dothēsetai kai perisseuthēsetai tou de mē echontos kai ho echei arthēsetai ap’ autou
verses.literal: For everyone who has will be given more and he will have an abundance But the one who does not have even what he has will be taken away from him

verses.original: καὶ τὸν ἀχρεῖον δοῦλον ἐκβάλετε εἰς τὸ σκότος τὸ ἐξώτερον ἐκεῖ ἔσται ὁ κλαυθμὸς καὶ ὁ βρυγμὸς τῶν ὀδόντων
verses.transliteration: kai ton achreion doulon ekbalete eis to skotos to exōteron ekei estai ho klauthmos kai ho brygmos tōn odontōn
verses.literal: And throw that worthless servant into the outer darkness where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth

verses.original: Ὅταν δὲ ἔλθῃ ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐν τῇ δόξῃ αὐτοῦ καὶ πάντες οἱ ἄγγελοι μετ’ αὐτοῦ τότε καθίσει ἐπὶ θρόνου δόξης αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Hotan de elthē ho huios tou anthrōpou en tē doxē autou kai pantes hoi angeloi met’ autou tote kathisei epi thronou doxēs autou
verses.literal: When the Son of Man comes in His glory and all the angels with Him He will sit on His glorious throne

verses.original: καὶ συναχθήσονται ἔμπροσθεν αὐτοῦ πάντα τὰ ἔθνη καὶ ἀφορίσει αὐτοὺς ἀπ’ ἀλλήλων ὥσπερ ὁ ποιμὴν ἀφορίζει τὰ πρόβατα ἀπὸ τῶν ἐρίφων
verses.transliteration: kai synachthēsontai emprosthen autou panta ta ethnē kai aphorisei autous ap’ allēlōn hōsper ho poimēn aphorizei ta probata apo tōn eriphōn
verses.literal: All the nations will be gathered before Him and He will separate the people one from another as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats

verses.original: καὶ στήσει τὰ μὲν πρόβατα ἐκ δεξιῶν αὐτοῦ τὰ δὲ ἐρίφια ἐξ εὐωνύμων
verses.transliteration: kai stēsei ta men probata ek dexiōn autou ta de eriphia ex euōnymōn
verses.literal: He will place the sheep on His right and the goats on His left

verses.original: Τότε ἐρεῖ ὁ Βασιλεὺς τοῖς ἐκ δεξιῶν αὐτοῦ Δεῦτε οἱ εὐλογημένοι τοῦ Πατρός μου κληρονομήσατε τὴν ἡτοιμασμένην ὑμῖν βασιλείαν ἀπὸ καταβολῆς κόσμου
verses.transliteration: Tote erei ho Basileus tois ek dexiōn autou Deute hoi eulogēmenoi tou Patros mou klēronomēsate tēn hētoimasmenēn hymin basileian apo katabolēs kosmou
verses.literal: Then the King will say to those on His right Come you who are blessed by My Father inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world

verses.original: ἐπείνασα γὰρ καὶ ἐδώκατέ μοι φαγεῖν ἐδίψησα καὶ ἐποτίσατέ με ξένος ἤμην καὶ συνηγάγετέ με
verses.transliteration: epeinasa gar kai edōkate moi phagein edipsēsa kai epotisate me xenos ēmēn kai synēgagete me
verses.literal: For I was hungry and you gave Me something to eat I was thirsty and you gave Me something to drink I was a stranger and you took Me in . . .

verses.original: γυμνὸς καὶ περιεβάλετέ με ἠσθένησα καὶ ἐπεσκέψασθέ με ἐν φυλακῇ ἤμην καὶ ἤλθατε πρός με
verses.transliteration: gymnos kai periebalete me ēsthenēsa kai epeskepsasthe me en phylakē ēmēn kai ēlthate pros me
verses.literal: I was naked and you clothed Me I was sick and you looked after Me I was in prison and you visited . . . Me

verses.original: Τότε ἀποκριθήσονται αὐτῷ οἱ δίκαιοι λέγοντες Κύριε πότε σε εἴδομεν πεινῶντα καὶ ἐθρέψαμεν ἢ διψῶντα καὶ ἐποτίσαμεν
verses.transliteration: Tote apokrithēsontai autō hoi dikaioi legontes Kyrie pote se eidomen peinōnta kai ethrepsamen ē dipsōnta kai epotisamen
verses.literal: Then the righteous will answer Him Lord when did we see You hungry and feed You or thirsty and give You something to drink

verses.original: πότε δέ σε εἴδομεν ξένον καὶ συνηγάγομεν ἢ γυμνὸν καὶ περιεβάλομεν
verses.transliteration: pote de se eidomen xenon kai synēgagomen ē gymnon kai periebalomen
verses.literal: When did we see You a stranger and take You in or naked and clothe You

verses.original: πότε δέ σε εἴδομεν ἀσθενοῦντα ἢ ἐν φυλακῇ καὶ ἤλθομεν πρός σε
verses.transliteration: pote de se eidomen asthenounta ē en phylakē kai ēlthomen pros se
verses.literal: When did we see You sick or in prison and visit . . . You

verses.original: Καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ Βασιλεὺς ἐρεῖ αὐτοῖς Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ἐφ’ ὅσον ἐποιήσατε ἑνὶ τούτων τῶν ἀδελφῶν μου τῶν ἐλαχίστων ἐμοὶ ἐποιήσατε
verses.transliteration: Kai apokritheis ho Basileus erei autois Amēn legō hymin eph’ hoson epoiēsate heni toutōn tōn adelphōn mou tōn elachistōn emoi epoiēsate
verses.literal: And the King will reply . . . Truly I tell you whatever . . . you did for one of the least of these brothers of Mine you did for Me

verses.original: Τότε ἐρεῖ καὶ τοῖς ἐξ εὐωνύμων Πορεύεσθε ἀπ’ ἐμοῦ οἱ κατηραμένοι εἰς τὸ πῦρ τὸ αἰώνιον τὸ ἡτοιμασμένον τῷ διαβόλῳ καὶ τοῖς ἀγγέλοις αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Tote erei kai tois ex euōnymōn Poreuesthe ap’ emou hoi katēramenoi eis to pyr to aiōnion to hētoimasmenon tō diabolō kai tois angelois autou
verses.literal: Then He will say to those on His left Depart from Me you who are cursed into the eternal fire prepared for the devil and his angels

verses.original: ἐπείνασα γὰρ καὶ οὐκ ἐδώκατέ μοι φαγεῖν καὶ ἐδίψησα καὶ οὐκ ἐποτίσατέ με
verses.transliteration: epeinasa gar kai ouk edōkate moi phagein kai edipsēsa kai ouk epotisate me
verses.literal: For I was hungry and you gave Me nothing to eat I was thirsty and you gave Me nothing to drink . . . . . .

verses.original: ξένος ἤμην καὶ οὐ συνηγάγετέ με γυμνὸς καὶ οὐ περιεβάλετέ με ἀσθενὴς καὶ ἐν φυλακῇ καὶ οὐκ ἐπεσκέψασθέ με
verses.transliteration: xenos ēmēn kai ou synēgagete me gymnos kai ou periebalete me asthenēs kai en phylakē kai ouk epeskepsasthe me
verses.literal: I was a stranger and you did not take Me in . . . I was naked and you did not clothe Me I was sick and in prison and you did not look after Me

verses.original: Τότε ἀποκριθήσονται καὶ αὐτοὶ λέγοντες Κύριε πότε σε εἴδομεν πεινῶντα ἢ διψῶντα ἢ ξένον ἢ γυμνὸν ἢ ἀσθενῆ ἢ ἐν φυλακῇ καὶ οὐ διηκονήσαμέν σοι
verses.transliteration: Tote apokrithēsontai kai autoi legontes Kyrie pote se eidomen peinōnta ē dipsōnta ē xenon ē gymnon ē asthenē ē en phylakē kai ou diēkonēsamen soi
verses.literal: And they too will reply Lord when did we see You hungry or thirsty or a stranger or naked or sick or in prison and did not minister to You

verses.original: Τότε ἀποκριθήσεται αὐτοῖς λέγων Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ἐφ’ ὅσον οὐκ ἐποιήσατε ἑνὶ τούτων τῶν ἐλαχίστων οὐδὲ ἐμοὶ ἐποιήσατε
verses.transliteration: Tote apokrithēsetai autois legōn Amēn legō hymin eph’ hoson ouk epoiēsate heni toutōn tōn elachistōn oude emoi epoiēsate
verses.literal: Then the King will answer . . . Truly I tell you whatever . . . you did not do for one of the least of these you did not do for Me

verses.original: Καὶ ἀπελεύσονται οὗτοι εἰς κόλασιν αἰώνιον οἱ δὲ δίκαιοι εἰς ζωὴν αἰώνιον
verses.transliteration: Kai apeleusontai houtoi eis kolasin aiōnion hoi de dikaioi eis zōēn aiōnion
verses.literal: And they will go away into eternal punishment but the righteous into eternal life
